## Summary

Describe the change and its user impact.

## Scope and architecture

- [ ] Android, backend, documentation, or repository configuration scope is identified.
- [ ] Existing README content is preserved unless an approved change explicitly says otherwise.
- [ ] Deferred functionality is not described as implemented.

## Validation evidence

- [ ] Formatting/lint/type-check/unit-test results are listed with commands and outcomes.
- [ ] Android build or backend build result is listed, including environmental blockers.
- [ ] Relevant screenshots/logs or test evidence are attached when useful.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, signing material, private certificates, or production data are included.
- [ ] WebView, API, dependency, and privacy implications are considered.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated where needed.

## Remaining work

List known limitations, follow-up issues, and deferred requirements.
